content.text:
I made a few small fixes to `0.html`. The page was already in good shape (responsive, dark mode, reduced motion and high-contrast support, keyboard focus styles), so I didn't restructure anything. I haven't tested these changes in a browser yet.

1. **The color fade probably didn't work.** The circle's fill uses `currentColor`, and browsers generally won't animate a fill set that way when the underlying color changes, so it most likely just jumped to the new color. I moved the transition to the button's `color`, which is the value that actually changes. That should make the 0.4s fade work.
2. **Screen readers now read the current color and instructions.** When the button gets focus, it now reads out the current color and the hint text, so screen reader users hear more than just "Change circle color."
3. **Clearer wording.** The hint now says "Enter or Space" instead of "Enter/Space", which reads better aloud.

I first tried to make these changes with a single Python script, but that needed approval and no one can approve prompts in this session, so it was blocked. I made the same edits one at a time with the file editor instead.
